# netbox_rack_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/rackgroup/):

> Rack groups can be used to organize racks. A rack can be assigned to multiple groups.

Requires NetBox v4.6.0 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rack_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
  description = "test"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the rack group.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the rack group.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the rack group.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the rack group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the rack group.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the rack group was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the rack group was last changed.
- `rack_count` (Number) The number of rack objects that refer to the rack group.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_rack_group.example 1
```
